senses.gloss: , m. (v. תַּכָּא II) a low table or stool in the form of a shield, tabouret.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 119a:3">Sabb. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה יתיב את׳ דשינא וכ׳</he> (ed. Sonc. <he>אתק׳</he>; Ms. M. <he>דפילא</he>; Rashi quotes a Var. <he>דשאגא</he>; Ms. O. <he>דשיגא</he>) used to sit on an ivory stool (a teak stool) and fan the fire (for the Sabbath meals). Ib. 129ᵃ <he>צלחו ליה ת׳ וכ׳</he> split a teak stool for him (to start a fire on his day of blood-letting); a. e.—Pl. <he>תֵּכְתַּקֵּי</he>.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 31a:5">Bekh. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>קטיר להו … ת׳</he> wreathed four hundred stools for them.
<cite ref="Ketubot 77b:6-9">Keth. 77ᵇ</cite> <he>הוה יתיב … תכטקי פיזא</he> (corr. acc.) was seated (in heaven) on thirteen gold stools; a. e.
